headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Reynaldo López earning the win and Didier Fuentes notching the save. In other action, the Philadelphia Phillies took down the Chicago White Sox 9-5, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense, and the New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox 6-1, led by Jazz Chisholm Jr.'s home run and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Los Angeles Angels right-hander Jack Kochanowicz, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other notable injuries include Milwaukee Brewers pitcher Quinn Priester, who is out with right thoracic outlet syndrome, and New York Yankees catcher Austin Wells, who is on the 10-day injured list with cervical headaches.

The MLB trade market was active, with several notable deals taking place. The Chicago Cubs acquired left-handed pitcher Antoine Kelly from the Los Angeles Dodgers, while the Milwaukee Brewers traded for right-hander Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics. The Boston Red Sox also made a trade, acquiring left-hander Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates.

top_news.title: **Braves Edge Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 3-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Reynaldo López earning the win and Didier Fuentes notching the save.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 5-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings for the White Sox, striking out 3 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Dominate Red Sox in 6-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took down the Boston Red Sox with a strong performance, securing a 6-1 win. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Fall to Blue Jays in 4-6 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-6 in a closely contested matchup. Taylor Ward led the Orioles with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Adam Macko earned the win with 1 scoreless inning of relief.

top_news.title: **Angels RHP Jack Kochanowicz Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels right-hander Jack Kochanowicz has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Kelly Heads to Wrigley**
top_news.summary: Antoine Kelly, a left-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Chicago Cubs. The Los Angeles Dodgers dealt Kelly to the Cubs in a trade.
